profile.address: 971 North Gilbert Road, Suite 111, Gilbert, AZ 85234 (per operator's own site; differs from the 1955 South Val Vista Drive, Mesa address on file in OSM -- see research_note)
profile.reading: The Chatfield Group is a custom software and mobile app development firm, not a data center. The company's own site describes building process automation and integration solutions on top of the OptimumAI enterprise platform, work delivered as custom applications for client businesses rather than as hosted infrastructure. Chatfield lists its own address in Gilbert, Arizona, a few miles from the South Val Vista Drive location recorded here in Mesa, and nothing in its public materials mentions colocation, server hosting, or data center operations of any kind. The Mesa coordinates also sit at a location associated elsewhere with OptimumHQ, the product line Chatfield partners with, which likely explains why a mapping contributor connected the two names at one point. Software partners sharing a location pin is a common and mundane source of mapping confusion, not evidence of a shared physical data center. Given the mismatch between Chatfield's stated address and the tagged coordinates, and the complete absence of any infrastructure hosting language in the company's own description of its work, this listing reads as a mistagged point for a small application development business rather than a genuine data center facility.
profile.research_note: WebFetch of thechatfieldgroup.com confirms a custom software and mobile app development firm partnered with OptimumAI, listing its own address as 971 N Gilbert Rd, Gilbert AZ, distinct from the OSM tagged Mesa address (1955 S Val Vista Dr), which is shared with a separate OptimumHQ row in this table. No data center or hosting language anywhere on their site. Confident mistag.

reading.body:
The Chatfield Group does not publish data center specifications, and research indicates it is not a data center facility. The company's own website describes custom software and mobile app development services built on the OptimumAI platform, with its stated address in Gilbert, Arizona. The Mesa coordinates tagged here match no Chatfield business presence and appear to reflect a mapping error connecting a small application development firm to a shared office location.

This entry should be removed from any inventory of AI infrastructure. No power capacity, cooling specification, or hosting capability can be verified. No transition pathway from software services to colocation operations appears in any public material from the operator.

Arizona has 56 mapped facilities and 512 MW of published data center capacity across four operators. This facility contributes zero to either figure.
